Chapter 822: Chapter 22 Visiting Martial Ancestor (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 822: Chapter 22 Visiting Martial Ancestor (Please Subscribe)_3

Like these Perfect Demon True Lords, most are either roaming the Boundless Void or dwelling long in the Void Secret Realm. As for cowering within a single world? That would be too stifling.

“Tianqing World…”

The Child of the Void carefully observed the ‘Tianqing-colored’ world in its original location.

Intense fluctuations of space-time were almost overflowing, and under such fluctuations, the Child of the Void was entirely unable to obtain any slight information about the Tianqing World, unable to reverse time to glimpse the past of the Tianqing World.

“Is it truly entering the Tenth Stage, or like me, becoming the keeper of some Tenth Stage legacy treasure?”

The Child of the Void did not reach a conclusion. Although whichever possibility it was, he would no longer oppose the Martial Ancestor, it decided the Child of the Void’s final attitude towards the Martial Ancestor.

...

“Great Child of the Void, should I go inform that Martial Ancestor… that we are right outside?” Lord Divine Eye glanced and tentatively asked.

“Inform the Martial Ancestor?”

The Child of the Void glanced at Lord Divine Eye.

Even if it was not possible to determine right now, which possibility the Martial Ancestor actually was, even if it was the lowest possibility, he was still an existence at the same level as the Child of the Void.

Under such circumstances, go inform the Martial Ancestor?

The Child of the Void naturally wasn’t foolish, facing weaker ones, he was naturally absolutely domineering, but facing at least an equal existence like the Martial Ancestor, who might even surpass him.

The Child of the Void knew what to do.

“We just wait here.”

The Child of the Void said indifferently.

With the Martial Ancestor’s strength, he must have already noticed their arrival.

If he wanted to meet, he would naturally appear.

If he didn’t want to meet, even if Lord Divine Eye went to inform, they wouldn’t be able to meet.

“Yes…”

Lord Divine Eye steadied his spirit, and also knew that his previous words were inappropriate.

…

Tianqing World.

The appearance of the Child of the Void and many Demonic Divine Masters, although they tried as much as possible to conceal their aura, and were waiting quite far away from the world,

Still, it influenced the creatures within the world. There was no help, the suppression coming from the Demonic Divine Masters was simply too strong, especially the cohort of Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, as well as the existence of the Child of the Void, who governed the Void Secret Realm.

At this moment, any Demonic Divine Master standing outside the world possessed the strength to easily swallow the entire Tianqing World.

“Those… Are those Demonic Divine Masters?”

Great Priest Qingyao briefly connected mentally with the Ancestral Demon Tree, sensing the vague outlines of the Child of the Void and many Demonic Divine Masters, and her spirit trembled uneasily.

The intense fluctuations of space-time originating deep within the Martial Hall, in the eyes of the Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, appeared as conspicuous as the great sun in the sky, but to the creatures within the world, they were completely imperceptible.

The gap in levels was simply too vast, the ordinary beings couldn’t even perceive the basic spatial fluctuations, not to mention the Fusion of Time and Space?

However, although Great Priest Qingyao couldn’t discern the changes coming deep within the Martial Hall, she distinctly felt, at this moment outside the world, the terrifying contours of each Demonic Divine Master.

The aura revealed by any Demonic Divine Master’s contour could destroy the Tianqing World hundreds to thousands of times, as remembered by Great Priest Qingyao.

“It’s over.”

Great Priest Qingyao felt completely hopeless. Hundreds of years ago, facing the invasion of the ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’, she still had the courage to resist or even undertake a fight to mutual destruction.

But now, the indescribable contours of the Demonic Divine Masters outside the world stifled even the thought of resistance in Great Priest Qingyao.

The only thing Great Priest Qingyao couldn’t understand was why those inexpressibly powerful Demonic Divine Masters were now quietly standing outside the world, showing no hint of making a move.

…

Deep within the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan carefully sensed the changes within himself, as a miniature formation of a River of Space-Time began taking shape inside his internal world, causing his internal world to begin transforming, which in turn greatly elevated Lin Yuan’s physical and soul capacities.

As for the will of the heart? The body nurtures the soul, and the soul nurtures the will of the heart. Logically, the transformation of the internal world would also affect the will of the heart.

But Lin Yuan’s will of the heart was now incredibly strong, having reached an all-encompassing level, thus barely undergoing any change.

Lin Yuan’s current strength of will, he estimated, would only be impacted when attempting to break through the Eleventh Stage, or perhaps directly during the ultimate breakthrough.

The stronger the will of the heart, the more difficult it is to enhance, especially reaching ten million points, which can’t be improved just by experiencing the passage of time.

Before reaching ten million points in the will of the heart index, the longer one lives, the greater the impact on the will of the heart, but once past ten million points, this impact rapidly diminishes.

“Those Demonic Divine Masters have come?”

Lin Yuan scanned outside the world, with his current level, he had already sensed the presence of those Demonic Divine Masters, including the Child of the Void within his perception.

For Lin Yuan, the existence of the Child of the Void was quite special; he was connected with that Void Secret Realm, able to resonate at any moment between the two.

“Never mind, let’s deal with them first.”

Lin Yuan stood up, took a step forward, and appeared outside the Martial Hall.

“Martial Ancestor.”

Seeing Lin Yuan, Great Priest Qingyao immediately spoke with utmost gravity: “Many powerful Demonic Divine Masters suddenly appeared outside…”

“No matter.”

Lin Yuan shook his head and said, “They are here to pay respects to me.”

“Ah?”

Great Priest Qingyao was somewhat slow to react.

Those indescribably terrifying Demonic Divine Masters, were here to pay respects to the Martial Ancestor?

To pay respects?

…

Outside the world.

The Child of the Void and many Demonic Divine Masters quietly waited.

Including the Child of the Void, no Demonic Divine Master revealed any signs of impatience.

At that moment.

“Whoosh!”

An intangible wave of space-time arrived, appearing before all the Demonic Divine Masters, as a perfectly formed young man congealed, his eyes calm as the ocean of time and space, gazing at the many Demonic Divine Masters.

The body Lin Yuan was inhabiting was formed through ten thousand years of cultivation by the Ancestral Demon Tree using the Origin Source of the Tianqing World, naturally reaching a perfectly flawless state in all aspects, not a single flaw to be found.

“Martial Ancestor has come.”

The moment all the Demonic Divine Masters saw Lin Yuan, their level of nervousness escalated to the highest, incredibly cautious and earnest.
